title: Active sensing to characterize the heterogeneity of plant stress
abstract: arXiv:2608.27088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While most phenotyping platforms rely primarily on image-based measurements, advanced plant characterization requires the integration of active physiological sensing modali- ties such as chlorophyll fluorescence. We present an autonomous robotic platform designed to perform targeted fluorescence measurements on plant leaves. The system combines 3D plant reconstruction, geometric analysis, and motion planning to localize suitable measurement points and generate collision-free trajectories for a robotic manipulator.   A dense 3D model of the plant is reconstructed from multi-view data and used to extract candidate leaf surfaces based on orientation, accessibility, and sensing constraints. These targets are then integrated into a task-level planning framework that guides the end-effector to precise contact or near-contact configurations required for point-based fluorescence acquisition. translated_title: 主动感知表征植物胁迫异质性
translated_abstract: 尽管大多数表型平台主要依赖基于图像的测量，但高级植物表征需要整合主动生理感知模态，如叶绿素荧光。我们提出了一种自主机器人平台，旨在对植物叶片进行靶向荧光测量。该系统结合了3D植物重建、几何分析和运动规划，以定位合适的测量点，并为机器人操纵器生成无碰撞轨迹。从多视角数据重建植物的密集3D模型，并基于方向、可达性和感知约束提取候选叶面。这些目标随后被集成到任务级规划框架中，引导末端执行器达到点式荧光采集所需的精确接触或近接触配置。该平台实现了自动化、可重复且空间分辨的测量。
tldr: 本文提出一种自主机器人平台，通过3D重建和运动规划实现叶片叶绿素荧光的靶向测量，以主动感知方式表征植物胁迫的空间异质性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an autonomous robotic platform that enables targeted chlorophyll fluorescence measurements on leaves via 3D reconstruction and motion planning, actively characterizing spatial heterogeneity of plant stress.
